flags.observation: Intro runs four onboarding beats after the title line; the spec allows one to three.
'your Black Moment and your HEA both show up, if they pay their way' makes story beats act like people.
Outro punch works for normies but carries no expert dog whistle; no insider reference from deck, lore or Truby.
Triple-colon chain 'Cute, sure, but: Black Moment One: The Doubt:' blurs where opener, name and lore start when spoken.
'must face this specific opponent' has no subject; the fragment sounds cryptic by ear.
'Sunset deleted, so' repeats the 'so' opener family five beats after 'So, a cardboard Ex', again at beat 33; 'so' thrice.
'Cat and dog, bigger' and 'Off the plaza' call back to art images never sung; listeners cannot catch the reference.
'Or skip the summit' frames the Happy For Now as a lesser shortcut; the card source rates it equal to the HEA.
Line is power text only; the card's lore claim about sunsets substituting for depth is absent.
'what they want and are terrified to ask for' merges the card's two-sided contrast into a single object.
'not because of a dropped phone' dangles; the communication clause is cut, so the line lacks closure.
Style A sets a female lead while the lyric is first-person Uncle FrizzleBob; voice and persona clash.
